Research / Image / Invention

I’m Michael Needs, a documentary researcher, photographer and creative technologist based in Wales. I hold a master’s in photography and bring over a decade of experience across film, television and photography.

My work moves between investigation and image making. I follow difficult leads, then help shape how a story is filmed, presented and understood.

01 / Investigation and production

Imposter: The Man Who Came Back from the Dead

A four-part documentary about Nicholas Rossi, first shown on Channel 4 and now listed on Disney+ in the UK.

I investigated Nicholas Rossi’s online identities, connected accounts and followed leads across a complex story. I also worked on cinematography, lighting and scene building, and designed the TX poster shown here. It credits my cinematography under Mike Needs, alongside Michael Timney.

My contribution Investigation · Research · Cinematography · Lighting · Scene building · TX poster design
“Imposter would not have happened without Mikey, and that’s a fact.”Owen Phillips, Director of Imposter
See my Imposter work ↗Production page ↗Disney+ listing ↗
Original production still · Photography: Michael Needs
02 / Practical documentary production

Murder in the Valleys

Initially brought onto this Sky documentary series for lighting, I went on to work as a second camera operator, shooting car-rig material and pickups. I also photographed all of the official production stills. This was a hands-on role combining photographic judgement, lighting and the practical demands of documentary filming.

The series was nominated for BAFTA Cymru Factual Series in 2022 ↗.

My contribution Lighting · Second camera · Car-rig material · Pickups · Official production stills

A producer’s view

“Mikey is a polymath and a true creative one-off.”

Owen Phillips, Executive Producer
More from Owen

Mikey has been an integral part of many of the projects I have produced over the last six years.

Especially on Murder in the Valleys and Imposter: The Man Who Came Back from the Dead. Imposter would not have happened without Mikey, and that’s a fact.

His role has been dynamic and diverse, ranging from lighting DOP to AI researcher and almost everything in between.

A master of lighting and photography and produces beautifully original and glossy pitch decks, but in recent years he has moved into building a full AI R&D department that has been an ideas conveyor belt.

Mikey is a polymath and a true creative one-off.

Owen Phillips, Executive Producer

Independent research

Information / Systems / Measurement

What survives the journey?

My research explores how information changes as it moves through people, platforms and machines, and how its fidelity to a source might be preserved and measured.

Four research preprints connect questions about AI training data, information governance, photonic computing and information fidelity. Explore the papers and their interactive explanations.

Read the independent research ↗
Independent conceptual artwork
Production development / Public overview

DocuForge

I created DocuForge to help documentary teams discover their next compelling story. Combining years of investigative experience with bespoke AI development, it brings fresh possibilities into focus and gives producers a stronger starting point for their next film or series.

I led the project from initial pitch through development and delivery, shaping both the technology and the commercial framework behind it. That included drawing up the contracts with oversight from a leading European AI lawyer, taking an ambitious idea through to a working system for documentary development.

Built from production experience. Designed to spark the next great documentary.

My contribution Project leadership · AI development · Commercial framework · Delivery

Working together

A clear brief. Room to investigate.

I work with producers, commissioners and creative teams on defined assignments and through development. I’ve worked closely with multiple executive producers and commissioners across productions and development projects.

Bring me in for the part of a project that needs my eye and judgement:

  • Documentary research, source tracing and investigation
  • Story and episode development
  • Photography, camera and lighting
  • Pitch decks, treatments and visual development
  • Interactive pitch experiences
  • Practical AI tools and research workflows

We can agree the scope, deliverables and timing around the work. I’m based in Wales and available for remote collaboration or location work by arrangement.
